deviations: C4_PERF-COSMIC-16CAN (alternate, Walmart): the pick buys 1 x 12 (12 units, at most $24.96); the alternate buys 1 x 12 (12 units, at most $24.98)

not_simulated: Customers, the machine, the bridge and the student worker are made up (vending/simulate/world.py, bridge.py).

The agent's find_pack_price and the weekly price check's lookups make no web search: the tool isn't offered, the check runs as a dry run, and the world re-prices the sourcing table each Tuesday at 12:30.
Each agent run happens at one instant of the season's clock: a run that takes minutes live takes none here, so the run lease never expires mid-run and no deadline (60 min) is ever reached.
Model spend is test spend (purpose test) under a $4 daily cap, not the ledger's live spend.
The tracking check's money figures are compared with our own ledger's (the simulated bridge has no tax calculation of its own); only its counts are checked against the simulated machine.

Deliveries: one visit per request (Mon 30 Nov 15:00 for the fill, Friday for a weekly one); an Amazon line past its cutoff is paid, goes to back stock and is loaded by a later request's visit. Amazon always takes exactly two days; no store-side delays.
The worker runs in-process: no container, no /health, no restarts, no replicas, no network failures.
Visit-day live polls (vending.visit_polls) aren't simulated: the season polls hourly.
Catalog requests aren't decided: the round doesn't run sync_product_requests, so a request the agent files stays pending.
